section_summary.extract_value: This section reports hierarchical regression analyses examining whether Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) predicts self-esteem beyond Body Esteem Scale (BES) variables, conducted separately for women (n≈160) and men (n≈148). In both gender groups, BAS emerged as a significant negative predictor of self-esteem (women: β = -.25, p < .05; men: β = -.27, p < .05), accounting for 4% of variance in each group.
